title: Chipotle opening at Changi Jewel Airport in 2027
text:

 Chipotle opening at Changi Jewel Airport in 2027
 Chipotle.
 Nyi Nyi Thet 
 November 01, 2026, 11:24 AM
Imagr from Google Maps and Unsplash
 Chipotle is opening their first restaurant in Southeast Asia at Jewel Changi Airport in 2027. 
 Chipotle is a chain of fast-casual restaurants that specialises in customisable burritos, burrito bowls and tacos. 
 Chipotle had announced their intentions to open a while back, but did not confirm a location then. 
 According to a press release by Chipotle Singapore, the brand is operated by S&C Restaurants Holdings, a joint venture between Chipotle and Big Bite Company. 
 Big Bite Company, on the other hand, is an affiliate of Sangmidang Holdings, which already owns many major brands, including Paris Baguette. 
 Further information on the exact opening date, menu and launch activities will be revealed closer to the opening.
